comparisons.peer_topic: Chief Information Officer Committee Composition and Function
comparisons.peer_summary: The Chief Information Officer Committee serves as an escalation forum for technology senior management, including policy approval, and reports items to the Board's Technology Committee as appropriate.
comparisons.comparison: Similar to Goldman Sachs, which utilizes a Firmwide Technology Risk Committee co-chaired by the CISO to oversee cybersecurity and technology risk frameworks, Citi utilizes its Chief Information Officer Committee (CIOC). The CIOC also includes the CISO and serves as an escalation forum for technology senior management to approve policies and report items requiring further escalation to the Board's Technology Committee.

sentences.text: The Firmwide Technology Risk Committee is responsible for reviewing matters related to the design, development, deployment and use of technology.
This committee oversees cybersecurity matters, as well as technology risk management frameworks and methodologies, and monitors their effectiveness.

The Chief Information Officer Committee (CIOC), which consists of, among others, the Head of Technology and Business Enablement, Citi's Co-Chief Information Officers (who report to the Head of Technology and Business Enablement), the CISO, and the Head of TCCORO (who reports both to Citi's Head of Operational Risk within the Risk organization and its Head of Global Functions Compliance within the Global Legal and Compliance organization), serves as an escalation forum for items requiring the attention of technology senior management, including approval of policies, and reports items requiring further escalation to the Technology Committee of the Board of Directors, as appropriate.

comparisons.peer_topic: Board and Committee Oversight of Cybersecurity
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm's Board of Directors receives periodic updates from the CIO, CISO, and senior CTOC members concerning cybersecurity matters, including developments, policies, initiatives, and significant incidents. The Audit Committee and Risk Committee assist the Board in this oversight, while the Global Technology Operating Committee (GTOC) governs the Firmwide Global Technology organization and resolves key operational risk matters.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan disclose that their respective Board-level committees (Audit and Risk) assist in the oversight of cybersecurity matters. However, JPMorgan explicitly lists the CIO and CTOC members as the sources of periodic updates to the Board alongside the CISO, whereas Goldman Sachs specifies that its specialized Firmwide Technology Risk Committee (co-chaired by the CISO and CTO) reports directly to the Firmwide Enterprise Risk Committee to handle these reviews and monitoring responsibilities.

sentences.text: This committee oversees cybersecurity matters, as well as technology risk management frameworks and methodologies, and monitors their effectiveness.
This committee is co-chaired by our CISO and our chief technology officer, and reports to the Firmwide Enterprise Risk Committee.

As part of its oversight of management's implementation and maintenance of the Firm's risk management framework, the Firm's Board of Directors receives periodic updates from the CIO, the CISO and senior members of the CTOC concerning cybersecurity matters.
The Audit Committee and the Risk Committee assist the Board in this oversight.

peer_results.rationale: The retrieved candidates for MS describe the Firm Risk Committee (ms_2024_7_D211) generally overseeing the ERM framework and the Climate Risk Committee (ms_2024_7_D370) specifically for climate risk. There is no disclosed technology-specific or cybersecurity-specific risk committee with a mandate comparable to the GS Firmwide Technology Risk Committee's oversight of cybersecurity matters, technology design, and risk frameworks.
